title: American Ghostic
description: An affectionate parody of the famous American Gothic farmhouse portrait: a deadpan Space Ghost holds the pitchfork like a late-night interview microphone, while Zorak dressed in a prim Victorian collar looks intensely unimpressed beside him. The familiar steep farmhouse window contains one tiny glowing purple planet. Exquisite weathered wood, canvas brushwork and theatrical violet dusk.
